scientific_limitations: Assumes finite well-mixed sampling without replacement, strategy-independent group-size weights, positive geometric factors, and expected payoff comparisons; no conclusions for realized-payoff Fermi updating, assortative networks, arbitrary benefit functions, or fixation probabilities. title: A sharp four-person reversal and universal convexity of finite-population nonlinear public-goods selection
